displayIdentity.body: Jesus speaks about oaths tied to heaven, earth, Jerusalem, and one’s own head. He points to human limits and calls for a plain yes or no. He says anything beyond this comes from the evil one.
displayIdentity.title: Jesus places speech beyond a plain yes or no with the evil one
